<details><summary><strong>ERM-P040 — Design diversity as conditional common-mode mitigation</strong> — <code>REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROPERTY</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P040

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
Design diversity as conditional common-mode mitigation

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
N-version programming, diverse hardware/software channels and common-cause mitigation.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`FAULT_TOLERANT_COMPUTING_LINEAGE`, `SOFTWARE_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`, `DOMAIN_SPECIFIC`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`FAULT_TOLERANCE_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY`, `DOMAIN_TRANSLATION`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Develop multiple independent versions and vote to tolerate design faults.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Identical redundancy shares systematic faults; diversity may reduce common modes but independence is not guaranteed.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
At least one/adjudicated implementation remains correct for the target input/fault class without shared specification/model/tool failure.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Common specification ambiguity; difficult inputs induce similar errors; shared algorithm/library/data/model; voter/acceptance test wrong; diversity overwhelms maintenance.

**MECHANISM**  
Diversify selected causal dimensions; analyse shared assumptions; use independent evidence/teams/tools where valuable; test coincident errors; preserve diagnosability and update compatibility.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Systematic design/software/model failure dominates and consequence justifies multiple implementations.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Prefer one simple implementation plus strong specification/tests when diversity cost and shared assumptions erase benefit.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Clear specification/oracle, adjudication, independent causal pathways, configuration control, joint-failure evidence and maintenance capacity.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Can reduce some common design faults that identical replicas cannot tolerate.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Architect, mission authority, software/reliability owner and maintainer.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Correlated mistakes; shared training data/model; specification error; voter failure; patch divergence; extra interfaces and operational burden.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Knight–Leveson and Eckhardt–Lee directly undermine naïve independence; “different code” is not “independent failure.”

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
N-version slogans narrowed toward targeted causal diversity with explicit common assumptions, joint testing and lifecycle cost.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
A quantified/argued diversity case naming which common modes are reduced, which remain shared, adjudication coverage and maintenance/recovery consequences.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
Separate teams or languages are not the property; reduced joint failure for identified causes is.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROPERTY

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Homogeneous ecosystem updates can propagate broadly (SRC-061, SRC-062), but empirical multiversion studies show diversity cannot be assumed independent (SRC-014).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
Properly chosen physical, technological or supplier diversity can materially reduce specific common causes.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
How can diversity benefit be measured for modern AI/model/data stacks where many hidden assumptions are shared?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Admitted or rejected according to mechanism, trigger, assumption validity, evidence and anti-ceremony analysis.

**EVIDENCE_STRENGTH**
- `HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH`: `HIGH_FOR_SOFTWARE_EXPERIMENT`
- `DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH`: `CONTEXT_DEPENDENT`
- `ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY`: `VERY_HIGH`
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH`: `VERY_HIGH`

**PRIMARY_SOURCES**  
[SRC-013](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSE.1985.231893), [SRC-014](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSE.1986.6312924), [SRC-015](https://doi.org/10.1109/TSE.1985.231895)

**CRITICAL_SOURCES**  
[SRC-008](https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/pdfs/ADA066579.pdf), [SRC-052](https://www.nrc.gov/reading-rm/doc-collections/nuregs/contract/cr6268/), [SRC-054](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20240013667), [SRC-061](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/falcon-content-update-preliminary-post-incident-report/)

**MISSION_RELIABILITY_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The candidate is a supporting mechanism or rejected proxy rather than a standalone mission claim.

**FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE**
- `PROPERTY`: Design diversity as conditional common-mode mitigation
- `INITIATING_FAULT_OR_FAILURE`: Common specification ambiguity; difficult inputs induce similar errors; shared algorithm/library/data/model; voter/acceptance test wrong; diversity overwhelms maintenance.
- `LOCAL_EFFECT`: Loss, corruption, delay, false indication or degraded performance at the initiating item.
- `NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT`: Effect on the enclosing function, dependency path or maintenance process.
- `END_EFFECT`: Common specification ambiguity; difficult inputs induce similar errors; shared algorithm/library/data/model; voter/acceptance test wrong; diversity overwhelms maintenance.
- `PROPAGATION_PATH`: Functional, physical, state, timing, control, resource or organisational coupling.
- `CONTAINMENT_BOUNDARY`: A declared fault-containment region or explicit stop/degradation boundary.
- `DEPENDENCIES`: Clear specification/oracle, adjudication, independent causal pathways, configuration control, joint-failure evidence and maintenance capacity.
- `COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING`: Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.
- `LATENT_CONDITION`: Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.
- `DETECTION`: Outcome- or function-relevant observation, not a component heartbeat alone.
- `CONTROL`: Diversify selected causal dimensions; analyse shared assumptions; use independent evidence/teams/tools where valuable; test coincident errors; preserve diagnosability and update compatibility.
- `RESIDUAL_RISK`: Unmodelled combinations, dependence, coverage gaps and changed configuration remain.

**REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE**
- `PROPERTY`: Design diversity as conditional common-mode mitigation
- `REDUNDANCY_FORM`: Active, standby, voting, diverse, replicated or alternate-path redundancy as explicitly declared.
- `CLAIMED_TOLERANCE`: The specified number/class of faults tolerated while meeting required function or an accepted degraded state.
- `FAILURE_DOMAINS`: Physical, power, network, control-plane, state, software, supplier, operator and maintenance domains.
- `INDEPENDENCE_EVIDENCE`: Evidence must address shared causes rather than infer independence from copy count or labels.
- `COMMON_CAUSE_COUPLINGS`: Specification, design, implementation, environment, supplier, maintenance, configuration and operational coupling.
- `STANDBY_LATENCY_OR_DORMANCY`: Dormant faults, activation delay and cold/warm/hot readiness are measured when applicable.
- `SWITCHOVER_COVERAGE`: Detection, decision, transfer, state synchronisation and post-transfer functional success.
- `STATE_CONSISTENCY`: The takeover state and authority must be current, complete and semantically valid.
- `DEGRADED_MODE`: Declared reduced capability and exit conditions.
- `TEST_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE`: Representative failover/failure tests plus field or incident evidence where available.
- `MATURE_FORM`: A quantified/argued diversity case naming which common modes are reduced, which remain shared, adjudication coverage and maintenance/recovery consequences.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The candidate is not a diagnostic claim; outcome observation may still be required by its evidence profile.

**RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: No distinct recovery claim is made by this candidate.

**RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The property is primarily a design/operation mechanism; its validation still follows ERM-P026–P029.

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P041 — MTBF as a universal scalar for reliability</strong> — <code>CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P041

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
MTBF as a universal scalar for reliability

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Constant-rate electronic reliability prediction and repairable-system HPP practice.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`HARDWARE_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`, `LIFE_DATA_AND_STATISTICAL_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE`, `STATISTICAL_RELIABILITY_ANCESTRY`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Represent reliability by mean time between failures, often as the reciprocal of a constant failure rate.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
A convenient scalar is used to compare items and plan tests/spares.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
No standalone required function is protected; MTBF is an estimand only under a defined recurrent-event process and failure definition.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Mean hides mission time, hazard shape, tail, repair, severity, dependence and functional consequence; constant-rate premise is unstated.

**MECHANISM**  
Rejected as a universal property; retain MTBF only as a model-qualified descriptive measure with confidence and exposure.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Only when recurrent failures are reasonably represented by HPP/constant intensity or as an explicitly limited empirical mean.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Report exposure, failure count/intensity, uncertainty and mission reliability directly.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Stable failure definition, repairable-system process, representative exposure, constant-intensity validation if exponential inference is made.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Limited: compact planning/comparison measure inside its valid model.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Test planner, maintenance/logistics analyst or model user—not a generic mission consumer.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
“MTBF 100,000 h” read as life; reciprocal used without constant hazard; mixed failures; no confidence; predicted part rates summed as field truth.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
NIST makes the constant-rate assumption explicit; the National Academies critique documents handbook misuse and inaccurate predictions.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Universal slogan narrowed to one estimand among mission reliability, failure intensity, life distribution and availability measures.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Use only with declared model, failure population, exposure, confidence and decision; never substitute it for mission or field reliability.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
The target/slogan is ceremony when detached from model and mission.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Field and incident data show severity and correlated outages can dominate a mean interval.

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
MTBF remains mathematically coherent and operationally useful in some stationary repairable-system contexts.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
What communication formats most reliably prevent non-experts from reading MTBF as expected lifetime?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Rejected as a general engineering property; retained only as a model-qualified metric.

**EVIDENCE_STRENGTH**
- `HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH`: `HIGH_WITHIN_MODEL`
- `LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH`: `MIXED`
- `DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_TO_MODERATE`
- `TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_AS_UNIVERSAL`
- `ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY`: `VERY_HIGH`
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH`: `VERY_HIGH`

**PRIMARY_SOURCES**  
[SRC-043](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/apr/section3/apr311.htm), [SRC-044](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/apr/section4/apr451.htm)

**CRITICAL_SOURCES**  
[SRC-041](https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/apr/section1/apr124.htm), [SRC-046](https://doi.org/10.1109/TR.2002.804492), [SRC-047](https://www.nationalacademies.org/read/18987/chapter/17)

- `REQUIRED_FUNCTION`: No standalone required function is protected; MTBF is an estimand only under a defined recurrent-event process and failure definition.
- `MISSION_OR_SERVICE`: No standalone required function is protected; MTBF is an estimand only under a defined recurrent-event process and failure definition.

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P042 — “Five nines” as a universal service-reliability claim</strong> — <code>CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P042

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
“Five nines” as a universal service-reliability claim

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Telecommunications/high-availability uptime targets and later service marketing/SRE shorthand.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION`, `DOMAIN_SPECIFIC`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION`, `DOMAIN_TRANSLATION`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Express annual allowed downtime by counting nines of availability.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Communicate a compact availability objective.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
No universal function; validity requires a specific SLI, denominator, scope, consumer, window and exclusions.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Nines hide whether failures are one long outage or many interruptions, which users/regions/journeys count, degraded service, data correctness and correlated dependency loss.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject the slogan as evidence; translate to consumer journeys, outage distribution, tails, consequence and recovery objectives.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Only as shorthand after full metric semantics are already defined and understood.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
State maximum tolerable outage patterns or direct user/mission outcomes instead.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Valid SLI/denominator, complete telemetry, user weighting, interval, planned-maintenance treatment and outage-shape analysis.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Limited communication convenience.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Service stakeholders who already understand the full definition.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Marketing without scope; request-weighting; excluded windows; short-outage accumulation; partial outage hidden; regional correlation.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
USENIX criticism directly questions whether counting nines reflects user experience and notes inability to distinguish outage shapes.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Nines were supplemented by user-focused SLIs, SLOs, burn rates, cohorts, tails and incident consequence.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Never claim reliability from the number of nines alone; publish the underlying outcome distribution and scope.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
The nines badge is the ceremony.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Large correlated outages can dominate consequence even when annual percentage remains numerically high (SRC-058, SRC-059, SRC-062).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
A well-defined availability percentage can be useful for capacity/contract decisions; the universal branding is rejected.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
Which outage-shape and cohort summaries best accompany a percentage without overwhelming public communication?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Rejected as a self-sufficient reliability claim; retained only as shorthand for an already defined availability measure.

**EVIDENCE_STRENGTH**
- `HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH`: `HIGH_FOR_DEFINED_AVAILABILITY`
- `LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH`: `VERY_HIGH`
- `OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_TO_MODERATE`
- `TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_AS_SLOGAN`
- `ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY`: `VERY_HIGH`
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH`: `VERY_HIGH`

**PRIMARY_SOURCES**  
[SRC-063](https://sre.google/workbook/implementing-slos/), [SRC-083](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/)

**CRITICAL_SOURCES**  
[SRC-066](https://www.usenix.org/publications/loginonline/what-sre-could-be), [SRC-067](https://www.usenix.org/conference/srecon23americas/presentation/goins), [SRC-058](https://aws.amazon.com/message/41926/), [SRC-059](https://engineering.fb.com/2021/10/05/networking-traffic/outage-details/)

**MISSION_RELIABILITY_PROFILE**
- `PROPERTY`: “Five nines” as a universal service-reliability claim
- `REQUIRED_FUNCTION`: No universal function; validity requires a specific SLI, denominator, scope, consumer, window and exclusions.
- `MISSION_OR_SERVICE`: No universal function; validity requires a specific SLI, denominator, scope, consumer, window and exclusions.
- `OPERATING_PROFILE`: Declared demands, workload mix, duty cycle, mode changes and maintenance states.
- `ENVIRONMENT`: Declared physical, software, organisational and dependency environment.
- `FAILURE_DEFINITION`: Nines hide whether failures are one long outage or many interruptions, which users/regions/journeys count, degraded service, data correctness and correlated dependency loss.
- `DEGRADED_ACCEPTABLE_STATE`: Only states explicitly accepted by mission/consumer criteria; otherwise none.
- `MISSION_TIME_OR_DEMAND`: Specified interval, number of demands or service-measurement window.
- `CONSUMER`: Service stakeholders who already understand the full definition.
- `CHEAP_PATH`: State maximum tolerable outage patterns or direct user/mission outcomes instead.
- `MATURE_FORM`: Never claim reliability from the number of nines alone; publish the underlying outcome distribution and scope.

**FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: No distinct propagation claim is made by this candidate.

**REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The property does not itself claim redundancy benefit; any redundant implementation must invoke ERM-P008/ERM-P009.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The candidate is not a diagnostic claim; outcome observation may still be required by its evidence profile.

**RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: No distinct recovery claim is made by this candidate.

**RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE**
- `PROPERTY`: “Five nines” as a universal service-reliability claim
- `CLAIM`: Never claim reliability from the number of nines alone; publish the underlying outcome distribution and scope.
- `POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR`: Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.
- `CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY`: Exact hardware, software, data, model, dependency and procedure versions.
- `OPERATIONAL_PROFILE`: Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.
- `TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN`: Predeclared sampling/censoring, failure scoring, exposure and stopping rules.
- `MODEL`: Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.
- `ASSUMPTIONS`: Independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage and representativeness are explicit.
- `CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY`: Intervals, posterior uncertainty or bounded qualitative confidence; point estimates alone are insufficient.
- `CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS`: Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.
- `COVERAGE`: Claim coverage is limited to tested/observed failure modes, environments and paths.
- `DECISION_OR_CONSUMER`: Service stakeholders who already understand the full definition.
- `CHEAP_PATH`: State maximum tolerable outage patterns or direct user/mission outcomes instead.
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE`: A well-defined availability percentage can be useful for capacity/contract decisions; the universal branding is rejected.
- `EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS`: Evidence expires when configuration, profile, environment, support organisation or dependencies materially change.
- `MATURE_FORM`: Never claim reliability from the number of nines alone; publish the underlying outcome distribution and scope.

</details>
<details><summary><strong>ERM-P043 — Universal bathtub-curve assumption</strong> — <code>REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P043

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
Universal bathtub-curve assumption

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Early lifetime/hazard modelling and an influential three-phase graphical idealisation.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`LIFE_DATA_AND_STATISTICAL_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`STATISTICAL_RELIABILITY_ANCESTRY`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Assume every product has infant mortality, a constant-hazard useful life, then wear-out.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Provide an intuitive lifecycle story for screening, random failures and replacement.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
No standalone mission property; it is a candidate hazard-shape model.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Observed modes/populations do not exhibit all phases; mixtures create aggregate shape; item changes/maintenance violate stationary phases; policy follows the sketch rather than data/mechanism.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject universality; fit/compare distributions and mechanisms, stratify populations, use repairable-event models where appropriate.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Use only when mechanism and data support the relevant segment for the decision.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Plot empirical hazard/ROCOF with uncertainty or use a conservative nonparametric bound.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Life data with censoring, homogeneous enough population, mechanism knowledge, exposure and model diagnostics.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
Access, modularity, safe isolation, procedures, test equipment, spares, tools, skills, logistics, configuration data and time under actual field conditions.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Limited conceptual aid when its phases actually match the system.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Reliability analyst and maintenance planner.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Forced constant hazard; age replacement without wear-out; burn-in for non-infant modes; population mixture; repairable system treated as lifetime sample.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Peer-reviewed critique and RCM field evidence directly reject universal use.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
A universal lifecycle picture narrowed to one possible hazard pattern among many, with mechanism-specific maintenance.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Treat the bathtub as a hypothesis/teaching model, never an assumed empirical law.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
The curve on a slide is ceremony when it predetermines policy.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Nowlan and Heap’s aircraft component study documented six patterns and set mechanism-specific maintenance conditions (SRC-008).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
Some physical products genuinely show early defects, a useful-life plateau and wear-out; local use remains valid.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
How often are aggregate bathtub shapes artefacts of heterogeneous cohorts rather than individual mechanisms?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Universal form rejected; mechanism- and data-supported local hazard models retained under ERM-P022/ERM-P027/ERM-P028.

**EVIDENCE_STRENGTH**
- `HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH`: `HIGH_AS_POSSIBLE_MODEL`
- `LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH`: `HIGH_AGAINST_UNIVERSALITY`
- `DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE_TO_HIGH`
- `TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_AS_UNIVERSAL`
- `ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY`: `VERY_HIGH`
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH`: `VERY_HIGH`

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P044 — Handbook reliability prediction as field-reliability proof</strong> — <code>CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P044

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
Handbook reliability prediction as field-reliability proof

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
RCA and MIL-HDBK-217 component-rate prediction programmes.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`HARDWARE_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`, `LIFE_DATA_AND_STATISTICAL_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE`, `STATISTICAL_RELIABILITY_ANCESTRY`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Sum adjusted generic component failure rates to predict equipment MTBF before fielding.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Support design comparison, requirements allocation and early planning before sufficient field data exist.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
No direct field function is established by the table; it is a model output for a declared design/environment.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Outdated database, constant-rate form, missing mechanisms, wrong use conditions, deterministic point output and contractual ritual are presented as achieved reliability.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject equivalence; use physics/mechanism and field calibration, uncertainty, sensitivity and comparative purpose only where validated.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Early comparative design or planning when no better evidence exists and limitations are explicit.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Use qualitative stress/margin review, targeted tests and field analogues when a numerical point prediction adds false precision.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Technology/current data, environmental/profile match, mechanism relevance, uncertainty and calibration.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
At most, rough comparison or allocation under controlled assumptions.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Design/trade-study and planning authority—not final field acceptance.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Obsolete parts data; generic quality factors; no failure mechanisms; multiplicative factors; point prediction; inherited contractual target.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
The National Academies appendix reports gross over- and underprediction and concludes the method can mislead.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Generic handbook prediction narrowed/replaced by objectives-driven design, physics of failure, empirical field updating and uncertainty.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Prediction is labelled model-based, comparative and uncertain; field/mission reliability requires representative evidence.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
A handbook calculation is ceremony when performed to satisfy a deliverable rather than inform a decision.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Technology and use-condition changes documented by the National Academies undermine direct transfer of old generic rates (SRC-047).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
Some calibrated prediction tools can rank design alternatives; the rejected claim is equality with field truth.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
What validation criteria are sufficient before a modern prediction model can support absolute rather than comparative claims?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Prediction retained as a bounded technique, rejected as evidence of achieved field or mission reliability.

**EVIDENCE_STRENGTH**
- `HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH`: `LOW_TO_MIXED`
- `DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_TO_MODERATE`
- `TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH`: `LOW_WITHOUT_CALIBRATION`
- `ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY`: `VERY_HIGH`
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH`: `VERY_HIGH`

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P045 — Completed FMEA/FMECA as proof that failure modes are controlled</strong> — <code>CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P045

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
Completed FMEA/FMECA as proof that failure modes are controlled

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Institutionalised FMEA/FMECA deliverables in military, aerospace, automotive and other programmes.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`FAILURE_ANALYSIS_LINEAGE`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE`, `SAFETY_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Complete and approve a worksheet listing failure modes, effects, criticality and controls.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Create systematic visibility and prioritisation of plausible failure modes.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
No mission protection follows from completion alone; each important mode needs effective prevention/detection/containment/recovery or accepted residual risk.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Copied modes; subjective ranks; missing interactions/software/human factors; “control” untested; document stale; rows closed by wording.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject completion claim; retain ERM-P006 systematic challenge and bind material rows to design/test/field closure.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Use a structured FMEA when bottom-up functional/component analysis is decision-relevant and proportionate.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Focused failure challenge or fault tree for the live top event when a full table adds no value.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Current design, competent participants, scope/ground rules, interface/dependence analysis and closure evidence.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
The method can find modes; completion itself has no independent payoff.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Design, reliability, maintenance and acceptance teams.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Checkbox culture; RPN arithmetic; row inflation; stale revision; controls without coverage; multiple-failure blindness.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Method limitations and bureaucracy are well documented; modern standards support tailoring rather than universal sufficiency.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Worksheet completion narrowed to objective-driven, cross-method, evidence-linked failure analysis.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Only claim that defined failure modes were systematically challenged and specific controls verified; never “FMEA complete, therefore reliable.”

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
The approved worksheet is the ceremony; ERM-P006 is the property.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Complex outages involve interacting change, dependency, state and recovery mechanisms that part-by-part completion can omit.

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
Well-executed FMEA remains useful and widely retained; only sufficiency-by-completion is rejected.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
Which observable indicators distinguish a live, decision-effective FMEA from a compliant but inert one?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Worksheet completion rejected as a property; systematic failure challenge retained as ERM-P006.

**EVIDENCE_STRENGTH**
- `HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `FORMAL_OR_PROBABILISTIC_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `LIFE_DATA_OR_FIELD_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `DEMONSTRATION_TEST_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `INCIDENT_OR_FAILURE_CASE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `OPERATIONAL_PRACTICE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`
- `REPLICATION_OR_MULTI_STUDY_STRENGTH`: `MODERATE`
- `TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH`: `HIGH_FOR_CRITIQUE`
- `ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY`: `HIGH`
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH`: `HIGH`

[SRC-004](https://quicksearch.dla.mil/qsDocDetails.aspx?ident_number=37027), [SRC-035](https://tc56.iec.ch/dependability-standards/)

**CRITICAL_SOURCES**  
[SRC-005](https://www.nrc.gov/reading-rm/doc-collections/nuregs/staff/sr0492/), [SRC-079](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cosrev.2015.03.001), [SRC-058](https://aws.amazon.com/message/41926/), [SRC-060](https://about.gitlab.com/blog/postmortem-of-database-outage-of-january-31/)

**MISSION_RELIABILITY_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The candidate is a supporting mechanism or rejected proxy rather than a standalone mission claim.

**FAILURE_PROPAGATION_PROFILE**
- `PROPERTY`: Completed FMEA/FMECA as proof that failure modes are controlled
- `INITIATING_FAULT_OR_FAILURE`: Copied modes; subjective ranks; missing interactions/software/human factors; “control” untested; document stale; rows closed by wording.
- `LOCAL_EFFECT`: Loss, corruption, delay, false indication or degraded performance at the initiating item.
- `NEXT_LEVEL_EFFECT`: Effect on the enclosing function, dependency path or maintenance process.
- `END_EFFECT`: Copied modes; subjective ranks; missing interactions/software/human factors; “control” untested; document stale; rows closed by wording.
- `PROPAGATION_PATH`: Functional, physical, state, timing, control, resource or organisational coupling.
- `CONTAINMENT_BOUNDARY`: A declared fault-containment region or explicit stop/degradation boundary.
- `DEPENDENCIES`: Current design, competent participants, scope/ground rules, interface/dependence analysis and closure evidence.
- `COMMON_CAUSE_OR_SHARED_COUPLING`: Shared specification, environment, supplier, control plane, state, maintenance or operator path must be challenged.
- `LATENT_CONDITION`: Standby, monitoring, repair or dependency defects may remain latent until demand.
- `DETECTION`: Outcome- or function-relevant observation, not a component heartbeat alone.
- `CONTROL`: Reject completion claim; retain ERM-P006 systematic challenge and bind material rows to design/test/field closure.
- `RESIDUAL_RISK`: Unmodelled combinations, dependence, coverage gaps and changed configuration remain.

**REDUNDANCY_COMMON_CAUSE_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The property does not itself claim redundancy benefit; any redundant implementation must invoke ERM-P008/ERM-P009.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: The candidate is not a diagnostic claim; outcome observation may still be required by its evidence profile.

**RECOVERY_RESTORATION_PROFILE**
- `APPLICABLE`: `false`
- `REASON`: No distinct recovery claim is made by this candidate.

**RELIABILITY_EVIDENCE_PROFILE**
- `PROPERTY`: Completed FMEA/FMECA as proof that failure modes are controlled
- `CLAIM`: Only claim that defined failure modes were systematically challenged and specific controls verified; never “FMEA complete, therefore reliable.”
- `POPULATION_OR_DENOMINATOR`: Declared units, missions, demands, requests, users, time windows or recurrent-event process.
- `CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY`: Exact hardware, software, data, model, dependency and procedure versions.
- `OPERATIONAL_PROFILE`: Representative demand/workload/environment with consequence-important rare cases identified.
- `TEST_OR_OBSERVATION_DESIGN`: Predeclared sampling/censoring, failure scoring, exposure and stopping rules.
- `MODEL`: Model selected for the stated estimand: life distribution, recurrent-event process, binomial demand, availability state model or direct functional check.
- `ASSUMPTIONS`: Independence, stationarity, censoring, repair effectiveness, acceleration, coverage and representativeness are explicit.
- `CONFIDENCE_OR_UNCERTAINTY`: Intervals, posterior uncertainty or bounded qualitative confidence; point estimates alone are insufficient.
- `CENSORING_AND_MISSINGNESS`: Right/interval censoring, unreported events, lost telemetry and excluded windows are recorded.
- `COVERAGE`: Claim coverage is limited to tested/observed failure modes, environments and paths.
- `DECISION_OR_CONSUMER`: Design, reliability, maintenance and acceptance teams.
- `CHEAP_PATH`: Focused failure challenge or fault tree for the live top event when a full table adds no value.
- `CONTRARY_EVIDENCE`: Well-executed FMEA remains useful and widely retained; only sufficiency-by-completion is rejected.
- `EXPIRY_OR_FRESHNESS`: Evidence expires when configuration, profile, environment, support organisation or dependencies materially change.
- `MATURE_FORM`: Only claim that defined failure modes were systematically challenged and specific controls verified; never “FMEA complete, therefore reliable.”

</details>
<details><summary><strong>ERM-P046 — Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved</strong> — <code>REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P046

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
Backup existence as proof that recovery is solved

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Backup and contingency-plan compliance.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`AVAILABILITY_AND_REPAIRABLE_SYSTEMS_LINEAGE`, `SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`MAINTAINABILITY_NATIVE`, `SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Verify that backup jobs run and copies exist.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Preserve data/artefacts for loss scenarios.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
Restored, authoritative and functionally usable state within RPO/RTO—not copy existence.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Stale/corrupt/inaccessible/incompatible backup; missing key/tool; incomplete application state; same disaster affects source; restore never tested.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject existence claim; apply ERM-P017 recurring restore/reconstitution validation.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Never sufficient alone; backup is one precondition in a recovery case.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
For reproducible stateless assets, verify build-from-source and one end-to-end check.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Integrity, freshness, isolation, tooling, configuration, capacity, procedures, state semantics and trained staff.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Copy existence has potential value only when the complete recovery path is valid.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Data/service owner and continuity authority.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Green job; empty archive; partial DB; wrong version; inaccessible credentials; unbounded restore time.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Incident evidence directly refutes the equivalence.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Backup compliance evolved toward restore exercises, functional validation and reconstitution.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Use ERM-P017; do not claim recoverability from inventory alone.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
Backup-count dashboard is the ceremony.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
GitLab had backup mechanisms that were not working and could not fully recover production data (SRC-060).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
A valid backup is necessary in many recovery strategies, just never sufficient.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
None affecting disposition; optimal exercise frequency remains context-specific.

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Rejected; superseded by tested restore/reconstitution ERM-P017.

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P047 — One failover test as proof of disaster recovery</strong> — <code>REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P047

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
One failover test as proof of disaster recovery

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
High-availability acceptance and disaster-recovery exercises.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`AVAILABILITY_AND_REPAIRABLE_SYSTEMS_LINEAGE`, `SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`FAULT_TOLERANCE_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY`, `SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Trigger failover once and record that the secondary became active.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Demonstrate transfer capability.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
Recovery across the relevant disaster/fault population, current configuration, representative state/load and postconditions.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Only nominal fault; shared control survives; secondary warm; no state divergence; no user journey; no return/failback; stale evidence after change.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject generalisation; maintain scenario/claim coverage, current configuration, correlated faults, load/state, recovery/failback and postcondition evidence.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
A failover test is one evidence item when it discriminates a live claim.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Directly verify the changed component/path after small changes; reserve full exercises for material uncertainties.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
ERM-P008/009, current state, representative fault/load, independent observability, abort and recovery validation.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
A valid recovery source, authorised action, state/data reconciliation, dependency readiness and independently checked return-to-service postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
A well-designed test supports the tested scenario only.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Continuity/service owner and acceptance authority.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Happy-path failover; no latent standby; control plane excluded; no load; state loss hidden; test environment unlike field.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Meta’s drills helped, but the actual global-backbone failure was outside exercised coverage.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Annual DR ritual evolved toward claim-based, configuration-aware scenario portfolios and continuous cheaper checks.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
State exactly which fault/state/load/postconditions the exercise established and which remain untested.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
The annual pass certificate is the ceremony.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Meta explicitly reported that its storm drills had never simulated global backbone removal, despite aiding recovery (SRC-059).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
Representative repeated exercises are powerful evidence; only one-test-to-general-DR inference is rejected.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
How should scenario portfolios be selected against evolving correlated failure distributions?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Rejected as general proof; individual tests retained within ERM-P017/ERM-P035 evidence boundaries.

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P048 — No incidents or lower incident count as proof of reliability improvement</strong> — <code>CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P048

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
No incidents or lower incident count as proof of reliability improvement

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Failure-count/growth tracking and modern incident metrics.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`SERVICE_RELIABILITY_OR_SRE_TRANSLATION`, `RELIABILITY_GROWTH_LINEAGE`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`SERVICE_RELIABILITY_TRANSLATION`, `RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Use fewer failures/incidents over time as evidence of improvement.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Provide a simple trend signal.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
No standalone function is established without exposure, severity, detection/reporting and configuration/profile context.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Lower demand; hidden/uncaught incidents; severity reclassification; fewer but larger correlated outages; reporting suppression; changed denominator.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject raw count; normalise by exposure/profile, stratify consequence and recurrence family, track latent/near-miss evidence and detection changes.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Use incident rates only with stable definitions/exposure and as one part of ERM-P024/025/028 evidence.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
For low counts, inspect each failure mechanism and consequence rather than model a trend.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Event definition, exposure, detection/reporting consistency, severity, configuration and recurrence families.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Limited signal when denominators and ascertainment are stable.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Reliability/service owner and decision authority.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Goodhart effects; ticket splitting/merging; reporting fear; observation changes; tail hidden by count.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Incident absence is compatible with latent failure, low exposure or weak detection.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Raw counts evolved toward exposure-normalised rates, user impact, recurrence and causal corrective-action evidence.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Treat count as descriptive; claim improvement only with stable exposure, detection and mechanism/impact evidence.

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
Incident-count OKR is the ceremony.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
CEREMONY_NOT_GENERAL_PROPERTY

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
Large low-frequency outages show count alone can underrepresent consequence (SRC-058, SRC-059, SRC-062).

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
With stable exposure/reporting and enough events, rates are valid evidence; raw count remains insufficient.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
How can near misses and latent faults be integrated without incentivising over-reporting games?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Raw count rejected as proof; contextual field feedback retained as ERM-P028 and recurrence as ERM-P025.

Green health check as proof that required function is available

Enable rapid automated routing and status display.

End-to-end required function with correct state, dependencies and performance.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Probe checks process existence/local loop; dependency/user path fails; monitor stale; partial/cohort failure; latent standby absent.

Reject equivalence; apply ERM-P011/ERM-P033 layered coverage and end-to-end functional checks.

A health bit can govern local routing only for the failure modes it demonstrably covers.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Execute a real safe user/mission transaction.

Coverage model, representative path, independent monitor and state correctness.

A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

<details><summary><strong>ERM-P051 — More redundancy always improves reliability</strong> — <code>REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED</code></summary>

**PROPERTY_ID**  
ERM-P051

**PROPERTY_NAME**  
More redundancy always improves reliability

**HISTORICAL_ORIGIN**  
Parallel RBD arithmetic and fault-tolerance intuition.

**LINEAGE_CLASS**  
`HARDWARE_RELIABILITY_LINEAGE`, `FAULT_TOLERANT_COMPUTING_LINEAGE`

**RELATIONSHIP_TO_OTHER_TRADITIONS**  
`RELIABILITY_ENGINEERING_NATIVE`, `FAULT_TOLERANCE_IMPORT_OR_SHARED_ANCESTRY`

**ORIGINAL_FORM**  
Add copies/paths so independent joint failure becomes less likely.

**PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED**  
Reduce random component failure probability.

**REQUIRED_FUNCTION_OR_MISSION**  
Improved mission outcome after specified faults, not increased component count.

**FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT**  
Common cause, voter/switch fault, dormant spare, state split, capacity/overload, maintenance complexity, update concentration or new interfaces dominate.

**MECHANISM**  
Reject monotonic slogan; apply ERM-P008/009/040 and compare total system reliability/maintainability under dependence and coverage.

**TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT**  
Add redundancy only when failure modes, domains, coverage, state and lifecycle burden support positive net value.

**NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH**  
Simplify/eliminate the failure cause, add a manual spare, improve repair, or accept risk when redundancy burden exceeds benefit.

**DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS**  
Common-cause model, transfer coverage, capacity/state, maintenance/support and evidence.

**OPERATIONAL_PROFILE_PRECONDITIONS**  
A declared and sufficiently representative operating profile, environment, duty cycle, mission phase and maintenance state.

**FAILURE_MODEL_PRECONDITIONS**  
A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Credible failure-domain independence, common-cause analysis, standby condition, switchover coverage and state compatibility.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Can be large under valid independence; can be negative otherwise.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Architect and mission/risk authority.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Shared power/control/specification; hidden standby; complexity; simultaneous maintenance; false failover; correlated release.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Formal and empirical literature directly show dependence can destroy the multiplicative benefit.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Copy-count reasoning evolved toward failure-domain, coverage, diversity, state and supportability cases.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
No redundancy claim without a total-system conditional argument and cheaper-path comparison.

- `INDEPENDENCE_EVIDENCE`: Evidence must address shared causes rather than infer independence from copy count or labels.
- `COMMON_CAUSE_COUPLINGS`: Specification, design, implementation, environment, supplier, maintenance, configuration and operational coupling.
- `STANDBY_LATENCY_OR_DORMANCY`: Dormant faults, activation delay and cold/warm/hot readiness are measured when applicable.
- `SWITCHOVER_COVERAGE`: Detection, decision, transfer, state synchronisation and post-transfer functional success.
- `STATE_CONSISTENCY`: The takeover state and authority must be current, complete and semantically valid.
- `DEGRADED_MODE`: Declared reduced capability and exit conditions.
- `TEST_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE`: Representative failover/failure tests plus field or incident evidence where available.
- `MATURE_FORM`: No redundancy claim without a total-system conditional argument and cheaper-path comparison.

**PROPERTY_ID**

Predictive maintenance universally outperforms simpler policies

Industry 4.0/AI predictive-maintenance promotion.

Lower mission/lifecycle loss than feasible alternatives under actual failure mechanisms and action constraints.

No precursor; weak labels; domain shift; false alarms; late warning; costly sensor stack; maintenance action itself harmful; benchmark not prospective.

Reject universality; use ERM-P023 comparative, uncertainty-aware, mechanism- and decision-valid assessment.

Only for observable degradation with lead time and effective intervention.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Potentially high in suitable mechanisms; absent or negative elsewhere.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Asset owner and maintenance planner.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
AI hype; accuracy metric not decision value; false work orders; missed failure; model maintenance burden.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Systematic reviews show heterogeneous evidence; current uncertainty review rejects certainty in RUL deployment.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**

A failure model appropriate to the estimand; distinguish non-repairable life, recurrent repairable events, demand failures, software activation and service outcomes.

**REDUNDANCY_OR_COMMON_CAUSE_PRECONDITIONS**  
No redundancy premise is needed; if redundancy appears in the implementation, common-cause and switchover assumptions must be analysed separately.

**DIAGNOSTIC_COVERAGE_PRECONDITIONS**  
Observable functional outcomes sufficient to determine whether the claimed property actually holds.

**RECOVERY_OR_REPAIR_PRECONDITIONS**  
No recovery premise is inherent; any claim that depends on restoration must invoke explicit recovery postconditions.

**MAINTAINABILITY_PRECONDITIONS**  
The design and support system must not make verification or corrective action infeasible.

**EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF**  
Can provide meaningful lower-bound evidence despite no observed failures.

**DECISION_OR_CONSUMER**  
Acceptance/test authority.

**KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES**  
Rule of three misapplied; unit-hours pooled; repeated demands dependent; success selection; no tail information.

**IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS**  
Primary statistical sources directly distinguish a minimum bound from zero risk or a life distribution.

**HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED**  
Zero-failure pass/fail evolved toward explicit confidence, dependence and censoring treatment.

**MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM**  
Publish exact test design and bounded inference; never “zero failures therefore reliable.”

**CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY**  
The zero-failure badge/certificate is the ceremony.

**CURRENT_STATUS**  
REJECTED_OR_DISFAVOURED

**EMPIRICAL_OR_FIELD_EVIDENCE**  
No incident history can rule out latent or correlated failures absent sufficient representative exposure.

**CONTRARY_EVIDENCE**  
Large representative independent success runs can strongly bound demand reliability; the unlimited inference is rejected.

**OPEN_QUESTIONS**  
How should rare common-cause dependence be incorporated when no joint failures are observed?

**DISPOSITION_RATIONALE**  
Zero-risk/unlimited claim rejected; bounded demonstration retained as ERM-P026.
